# Furnish it for 30-day-plus stays, rent it nightly, or lease it out? See what each nets.

> Free mid-term rental calculator: compare a furnished 30-day-plus rental with a long-term lease and with Airbnb-style nightly renting. See the monthly rate, empty days and furnishing payback that make it worth it. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
